verse: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression.
hadith: Actions are judged by intentions, so each man will have what he intended.
quote: If it is in your destiny, you can learn a lesson even from an ant. If it is not, even if the whole world is laid out before you, it is reversed.

verse: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment.
hadith: The rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim are five: returning the greeting, visiting the sick, attending the funeral, accepting the invitation, and responding to the sneezer.
quote: Do not hurt! You will be hurt from the place you hurt.

verse: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
hadith: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
quote: The secret to eloquent speech is to abandon unnecessary words.

verse: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
hadith: There are two blessings which many people lose: (They are) health and free time for doing good.
quote: If a person's knowledge is superior to their morals, their knowledge will only harm them.

verse: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
hadith: Make things easy and do not make them difficult, cheer the people up by conveying glad tidings to them and do not repulse (them).
quote: Whatever the heart is full of, the lips spill over.

verse: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
hadith: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
quote: Do not grieve! Whatever your trouble is, take ablution, lay out your prayer rug, and sit and cry. You will see that your trouble will shrink, and your heart will be relieved.

verse: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
hadith: The tale-bearer shall not enter Paradise.
quote: He who seeks the faults of others cannot see his own.

verse: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].
hadith: A believer is a mirror to another believer. A believer is a brother to another believer.
quote: The greatest wealth in the world is contentment.

verse: It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term.
hadith: Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement.
quote: Breaking a heart is like destroying the Kaaba.

verse: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.'
hadith: Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.
quote: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.

verse: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good.
hadith: He who is not merciful to others, will not be treated mercifully.
quote: Those who share the same feelings, not the same language, can understand each other.

verse: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving.
hadith: Part of the perfection of a person's Islam is his leaving that which is of no concern to him.
quote: What they think about you is their issue; just look at your own intentions.

verse: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
hadith: The believer is friendly and easy to get along with. There is no good in the one who does not get along with others and others do not get along with him.
quote: The heart is an ocean, the tongue is the shore. Whatever is in the ocean hits the shore.

verse: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two... saying to his companion, 'Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.'
hadith: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands the Muslims are safe.
quote: Let us love and be loved, the world is left to no one.

verse: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other.
hadith: Do not argue with your brother, do not joke with him in a hurtful way, and do not make a promise to him that you cannot fulfill.
quote: Even if you are hurt, do not hurt anyone.

verse: ...Say, 'Are those who know equal to those who do not know?' Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
hadith: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
quote: He who does not crack the walnut shell to reach its core will think the whole walnut is just a shell.

verse: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity...
hadith: Hold fast to the night prayer, for it is the practice of the righteous before you.
quote: The most beautiful place to be in life is inside a prayer.

verse: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
hadith: The example of the one who remembers his Lord in comparison to the one who does not remember his Lord, is that of a living creature compared to a dead one.
quote: He who keeps his secret will reach his goal.

verse: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance. And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
hadith: Supplication (Dua) is the essence of worship.
quote: Only the sick and the troubled know how long the night is.

verse: ...And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out. And will provide for him from where he does not expect...
hadith: If you all depend on Allah with due reliance, He would certainly give you provision as He gives it to birds who go forth hungry in the morning and return with full belly at dusk.
quote: Destiny is in love with effort.

verse: Every soul will taste death...
hadith: Remember often the destroyer of pleasures (i.e. death).
quote: Do not grieve for the past, and do not worry about the future. Just live in the present and trust in Allah.

verse: ...And whoever saves one - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely...
hadith: He is not of us who is not merciful to our young and does not recognize the honor of our elders.
quote: Knowledge is to know knowledge, knowledge is to know yourself.

verse: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace.
hadith: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
quote: He who prospers through cruelty will end up in ruin.

verse: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world...
hadith: Your body has a right over you, your eyes have a right over you and your wife has a right over you.
quote: Those who do not have thorn wounds on their feet cannot smear the scent of roses on their chest.

verse: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided...
hadith: The believers in their mutual kindness, compassion and sympathy are just like one body.
quote: Do not waste your love by remembering those who do not deserve to be loved.

verse: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
hadith: If you ask, ask Allah; if you seek help, seek help from Allah.
quote: If you do not live what you believe, you will start to believe what you live.

verse: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed [of grain] which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains...
hadith: Charity does not decrease wealth.
quote: Do not desire death, it will definitely come to you; prepare for death.

verse: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives.
hadith: Nobody has ever eaten a better meal than that which one has earned by working with one's own hands.
quote: Rely on Allah, embrace effort, submit to wisdom. If there is a way, this is it; I know of no other way out.

verse: He has succeeded who purifies it, And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
hadith: The true Mujahid (warrior) is one who strives against his own soul in obedience to Allah.
quote: The greatest ignorance is a person not knowing themselves.

verse: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
hadith: Smiling is charity.
quote: It is not easy to be a candle. In order to give light, one must first burn.

verse: We have certainly created man in the best of stature.
hadith: No father can give his child a better inheritance than good manners.
quote: The shadow of the crooked is also crooked.

verse: Eat and drink, but do not waste. Indeed, He does not like the wasteful.
hadith: Whoever deceives us is not one of us.
quote: To the man whose eyelids are closed, even daytime is night.

verse: Those who listen to the Word and follow the best thereof, it is they whom Allah has guided.
hadith: Whoever guides to a good deed is like the one who performs it.
quote: Do not forget, every dark night has a morning.

verse: Wherever you may be, He is with you.
hadith: I guarantee a house on the outskirts of Paradise for the one who abandons disputation even if he is in the right.
quote: Gold is refined by fire, man is refined by tribulation.

verse: Is the reward for good anything but good?
hadith: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another.
quote: Gone with yesterday is all that belonged to yesterday, my dear soul. Now it is time to say new things.

verse: And your Lord says, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.'
hadith: If you have no shame, then do as you wish.
quote: Justice is the foundation of the dominion.

verse: And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near...
hadith: A kind word is charity.
quote: Arrogance is like a stone tied to the waist. With it, one can neither swim nor fly.

verse: Do not turn your cheek away from people in contempt, nor walk arrogantly on the earth...
hadith: He whose neighbour goes hungry while he sleeps full is not one of us.
quote: Discipline your heart before you discipline your tongue; for speech comes from the heart and exits through the tongue.

verse: He merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night. He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts.
hadith: The world is the believer's prison and the disbeliever's paradise.
quote: In the presence of an ignorant person, be as silent as a book.

verse: O you who believe! Be steadfast witnesses for justice, even if it is against yourselves, your parents, or close relatives...
hadith: The strong man is not the one who throws others down in wrestling, but the one who controls himself in anger.
quote: The envious person grieves over the blessings of others and is blind to his own afflictions.

verse: And they who turn away from ill speech and idle pursuits.
hadith: Cleanliness is half of faith.
quote: He who does not cleanse himself cannot cleanse others.

verse: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
hadith: Two eyes will not be touched by the Fire: an eye that weeps from the fear of Allah, and an eye that keeps watch in the path of Allah.
quote: When the eye of the heart is blind, the vision of the physical eye is of no use.

verse: No bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another.
hadith: The religion is sincere advice (sincerity).
quote: Life is like a tale; what matters is not how long it is, but how beautifully it is lived.

verse: And worship your Lord until certainty (death) comes to you.
hadith: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
quote: I have seen many people with no clothes on; and I have seen many clothes with no person in them.

verse: And their affair is conducted by mutual consultation among themselves.
hadith: He who seeks counsel never regrets.
quote: The wise man uses his own mind and benefits from the minds of others.

verse: Indeed, prayer restrains from shameful and unjust deeds.
hadith: Prayer is the pillar of the religion.
quote: He whose character is beautiful will have many who love him.

verse: O you who believe! Fear Allah and speak words of truth.
hadith: Do not abandon truthfulness. For truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.
quote: Doing what is right is always the safest path.

verse: Say, 'Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
hadith: Richness is not abundance of goods, but richness of the heart.
quote: The world of the one whose heart is rich becomes vast.

verse: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are its expander.
hadith: There is a remedy for every malady. Allah has created a cure for every disease.
quote: Nothing in the universe is a coincidence; everything is in perfect order.

verse: He who made the earth a resting place for you and the sky a canopy...
hadith: Show mercy to those on earth, and the One in the heavens will show mercy to you.
quote: Mercy is the greatest adornment of humanity.

verse: There is no compulsion in religion...
hadith: May Allah have mercy on a person who is easy-going and tolerant.
quote: The lightning bolt of truth is born from the clash of ideas.

verse: He knows the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Most High, the Most Great.
hadith: Allah is in the aid of the servant as long as the servant is in the aid of his brother in faith.
quote: A candle loses nothing of its light by lighting another candle.

verse: O mankind! Indeed, the promise of Allah is true, so do not let the worldly life deceive you.
hadith: The intelligent person is the one who takes account of his own self and works for what comes after death.
quote: The world is a bridge; pass over it, but do not try to build a house upon it.

verse: Whatever is in the heavens and on the earth glorifies Allah.
hadith: There are two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales: Subhānallāhi wa bi-hamdihī, Subhānallāhi'l-azīm.
quote: Silence is much better than unnecessary speech.

verse: Indeed, We have granted you Al-Kawthar.
hadith: I have only been sent to perfect noble character.
quote: The knowledge of a person without morals is like a thief carrying a lantern.

verse: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers.
hadith: The believer who recites the Qur'an is like a citron, which has a pleasant fragrance and a pleasant taste.
quote: Books are the nourishment of the soul and the light of the mind.

verse: O you who believe! Why do you say what you do not do?
hadith: The signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is entrusted he betrays.
quote: Be as you appear, or appear as you are.

verse: Say, 'Truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Indeed, falsehood is bound to vanish.'
hadith: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand. If he cannot, then with his tongue...
quote: He who remains silent in the face of oppression becomes a partner to the oppressor.

verse: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon. Each is floating in an orbit.
hadith: Look at those who are below you in worldly status, and do not look at those above you.
quote: Contentment is an inexhaustible treasure.

verse: They remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth...
hadith: An hour of reflection (deep thinking) is better than a year of supererogatory worship.
quote: Speaking without thinking is like shooting without aiming.

verse: He grants wisdom to whom He wills. And he to whom wisdom is granted has indeed been given abundant good.
hadith: The world is sweet and alluring. Allah will place it in your hands and observe how you act.
quote: Take account of yourselves before you are taken to account.

verse: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment. On that day, a man will see what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, 'Oh, I wish that I were dust!'
hadith: The upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (receiving) hand.
quote: All words are true if you are true; no truth is found if you are crooked.

verse: O my son! Establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, these are matters of strong resolve.
hadith: Whoever does not thank people, does not thank Allah.
quote: Let the one who knocks on our heart, not on our door, enter.

verse: Those who avoid major sins and immoralities, except for minor lapses, indeed your Lord is vast in forgiveness...
hadith: The pleasure of Allah is in the pleasure of the parents, and the anger of Allah is in the anger of the parents.
quote: When the tongue falls silent, the heart finds peace.

verse: The mutual rivalry for piling up distracts you, until you visit the graves.
hadith: O Allah! Inspire me with right guidance and protect me from the evil of my own self.
quote: A word is your slave until you speak it; once you speak it, you become its slave.

verse: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
hadith: Backbiting is mentioning about your brother something he dislikes.
quote: Does distance from the eye mean distance from the heart? If it has entered the heart, what does it matter if it is far from the eye?

verse: He is Allah, besides whom there is no other deity. He is the Sovereign, the Holy, the Source of Peace, the Giver of Security, the Guardian, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supreme...
hadith: In times of tribulation, the one sitting is better than the one standing, and the one standing is better than the one walking.
quote: If I speak, it has no effect; if I keep silent, my heart is not content.

verse: And spend in the way of Allah from what We have provided you, before death comes to one of you and he says, 'My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous.'
hadith: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those that are consistent, even if they are few.
quote: Know that death is under your pillow.

verse: And those who say, 'Our Lord! Grant us from our spouses and our offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us a leader for the righteous.'
hadith: The best among you is the one who is best to his womenfolk.
quote: Love is in everything, but it is visible in nothing.

verse: When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.
hadith: Whoever has an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will not enter Paradise.
quote: He who speaks much errs much, and he who errs much has many sins.

verse: Say, 'He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal, Absolute. He begets not, nor is He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.'
hadith: Whoever among you wakes up safe in his home, healthy in his body, and having his daily sustenance, it is as if the whole world has been given to him.
quote: To leave behind works like giants, one must work like ants.

verse: Your Lord has not abandoned you, nor has He detested you.
hadith: Modesty is all good.
quote: Let people live so that the state may live.

verse: Do not think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He is only giving them respite until a Day when eyes will stare in horror.
hadith: When Allah wills good for someone, He grants him deep understanding of the religion.
quote: When everything comes upon you to a point you can no longer bear, do not give up; for that is the place where your destiny will change.

verse: Seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, it is a burden except for those who have a deep awe of Allah.
hadith: Oppression will be utter darkness on the Day of Resurrection.
quote: I would be a slave for forty years to the one who teaches me one letter.

verse: And We have not sent you, (O Muhammad), except as a mercy to the worlds.
hadith: The best of speech is the Book of Allah, and the best of guidance is the guidance of Muhammad.
quote: In this life, to retreat into seclusion and hear only the echo of your own voice does not lead a person to the truth.

verse: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
hadith: Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
quote: Let us get to know each other, let us make things easy, let us love and be loved, the world remains for no one.

verse: Do the people think that they will be left to say, 'We believe,' and they will not be tried?
hadith: A believer is not stung from the same hole twice (he does not make the same mistake twice).
quote: Time is like a sword; if you do not cut it, it cuts you.

verse: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they describe.
hadith: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your preoccupation, and your life before your death.
quote: Either you are hopeless, or you are the remedy.

verse: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them, and He placed between you affection and mercy...
hadith: When you are angry, be silent!
quote: The dignity of one who laughs too much diminishes.

verse: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves...
hadith: Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed, and it will wipe it out.
quote: Do not worry that your order is disrupted and your life is turned upside down. How do you know that the underside of life is not better than its upper side?

verse: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
hadith: The world is a temporary provision, and the best of its provisions is a righteous wife.
quote: A war is lost not when you die, but when you become like the enemy.

verse: Does He who created not know? He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.
hadith: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler along a path.
quote: Owner of goods, owner of property, where is the first owner of these? Goods are a lie, property is a lie, so come and idle a little while.

verse: Only those who have knowledge truly fear Allah among His servants. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might, Most Forgiving.
hadith: Knowledge is the lost property of the believer; wherever he finds it, he is more entitled to it.
quote: Beware of befriending a fool; for when he intends to benefit you, he harms you.

verse: Say, 'Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts it for him. And whatever you spend in His way, He will compensate it...'
hadith: The best of people is the one who is most beneficial to mankind.
quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.

verse: To Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah (His mercy and manifestation)...
hadith: Adhere to the night prayer, for it is the practice of the righteous before you, and it is a means of drawing closer to your Lord.
quote: Sorrow keeps the wound of love fresh.

verse: Indeed, the knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Allah. It is He who sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs...
hadith: Be detached from worldly possessions, and Allah will love you; be detached from what people have, and people will love you.
quote: Do not bend before injustice; for with your rights, you will also lose your honour.

verse: Say, 'If the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord are exhausted...'
hadith: Whoever takes a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him.
quote: He whose only concern is this world, will have as many troubles as the world.

verse: By time! Indeed, mankind is in loss. Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to truth, and enjoin one another to patience.
hadith: Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, do not turn your backs on one another, and be, O servants of Allah, brothers!
quote: Everything awaits its time; neither does the rose bloom before its time, nor does the sun rise before its time.

verse: Have you seen the one who takes his own desire as his god, and Allah has left him astray based upon knowledge?
hadith: The key to Paradise is prayer, and the key to prayer is ablution.
quote: No pain is more destructive than ignorance.

verse: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
hadith: By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, you must enjoin good and forbid evil, or Allah will certainly send a punishment upon you, then you will call upon Him but your prayers will not be answered.
quote: The heart is like a garden; whatever you sow, you shall reap.

verse: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
hadith: The example of a believer is like that of a fresh tender plant; from whichever direction the wind blows, it bends the plant, but when the wind dies down, it straightens up again.
quote: If your heart is pure, your outside will also be shining.

verse: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah is the destination.
hadith: The best friend is the one who brings you closer to Allah.
quote: We need a heart that sees with the soul, not just with the eyes.

verse: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment.
hadith: He who does not show mercy to our young or respect the rights of our elders is not one of us.
quote: Man is hidden beneath his tongue.

verse: Indeed, Allah does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight.
hadith: I guarantee a house on the outskirts of Paradise for one who leaves arguments even if he is right.
quote: The beginning of every matter is patience, and its end is salvation.

verse: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
hadith: Nobody can be given a blessing better and greater than patience.
quote: Friendship means being a rose, with both its petals and its thorns.

verse: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
hadith: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day must either speak good or remain silent.
quote: To break a heart is a greater sin than destroying the Kaaba.

verse: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their achievement; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
hadith: Whoever fulfills the needs of his brother, Allah will fulfill his needs.
quote: Those who do not know us, how can they understand? Greetings to those who do.

verse: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision.
hadith: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds.
quote: The truthful do not need to swear oaths.

verse: If you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
hadith: Intentions are the soul of deeds.
quote: Man is nothing but his thoughts.

verse: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you.
hadith: Whoever initiates a good practice will receive its reward and the reward of those who act upon it.
quote: No matter how much you know, what you say is only as much as what the other person understands.

verse: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
hadith: Allah helps His servant as long as he helps his brother.
quote: Reliance on Allah is tying the camel first, and then trusting Him.

verse: And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly.
hadith: Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.
quote: Earning a lawful income is nine-tenths of worship.

verse: The believers are but brothers.
hadith: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
quote: Brotherhood is reaching out to someone who is about to fall.

verse: Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
hadith: O Allah, You are forgiving and You love forgiveness, so forgive me.
quote: Forgiveness is the most beautiful revenge.

verse: Have you not seen that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs in the earth?
hadith: Whatever is eaten from a tree planted by a Muslim is charity for him.
quote: Be like the earth; cover everything and make it green.

verse: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance.
hadith: Whoever deceives us is not one of us.
quote: Justice is placing everything in its rightful place.

verse: Say, 'What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?'
hadith: Supplication is the weapon of the believer, the pillar of the religion, and the light of the heavens and the earth.
quote: Prayer is the heart's window to Allah.

verse: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
hadith: The one who severs the ties of kinship will not enter Paradise.
quote: Maintaining family ties lengthens one's lifespan.

verse: And tell My servants to say that which is best.
hadith: A good word is charity.
quote: Sweet words can coax a snake out of its hole.

verse: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
hadith: Seek the Night of Decree in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan.
quote: A life whose nights are the Night of Decree and whose days are Eid is a blessed life.

verse: Righteousness is not that you turn your faces toward the east or the west.
hadith: Righteousness is good character.
quote: Do good and throw it into the sea; if the fish don't know, the Creator will.

verse: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him.
hadith: Visit the sick, feed the hungry, and free the captive.
quote: Health is an invisible crown on the head of the healthy.

verse: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves. Grievous to him is what you suffer.
hadith: The closest of you to me are those with the best character.
quote: His (s.a.v.) character was the Quran.

verse: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam.
hadith: Arrogance means rejecting the truth and looking down on people.
quote: Humility is the ladder to greatness.

verse: Say, 'Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
hadith: No one will die until they have fully received their destined provision.
quote: Provision doesn't knock on the door; you must walk towards it.

verse: Cooperate with one another in goodness and righteousness.
hadith: The Merciful One shows mercy to those who are merciful.
quote: Be like the sun in compassion and mercy.

verse: He is the Cleaver of daybreak.
hadith: The two rak'ahs of the dawn prayer are better than the world and what it contains.
quote: The light of the morning is hidden in the prayers of the night.

verse: And hold firmly to Allah. He is your protector.
hadith: A strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than a weak believer.
quote: The one who takes refuge in Allah is like one who enters an indestructible fortress.

verse: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
hadith: Whoever swears by other than Allah has committed shirk.
quote: Servitude means waiting at the door.

verse: Read in the name of your Lord who created.
hadith: Islam is built on five pillars.
quote: Faith is a light in the heart that never goes out.

verse: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
hadith: Fasting is a shield; so when one of you is fasting he should neither indulge in obscene language nor should he raise his voice in anger.
quote: He who seeks a faultless friend remains friendless.

verse: Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills.
hadith: Islam began as something strange and will revert to being strange as it began, so give glad tidings to the strangers.
quote: Filter your words before speaking, string meaning like pearls.

verse: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
hadith: Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
quote: Even tears have a duty; they clean the way for the smile that will follow.

verse: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
hadith: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should be good to his neighbor.
quote: The world is a window; everyone who comes looks through and passes on.

verse: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another.
hadith: The believers in their mutual kindness, compassion and sympathy are just like one body.
quote: Undoubtedly, the greatest wealth is the wealth of the mind.

verse: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
hadith: There is a piece of flesh in the body if it becomes good the whole body becomes good but if it gets spoilt the whole body gets spoilt and that is the heart.
quote: The beauty of the mind is known through the tongue, the beauty of the tongue through words, the beauty of a person through the face, and the beauty of the face through the eyes.

verse: And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth.
hadith: The best of my Ummah are those who, when seen, remind you of Allah.
quote: Destiny is a beautiful possibility, when it comes from Allah.

verse: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.
hadith: All mankind is liable to error, and the best of those who err are those who repent.
quote: The seeker finds, the groaning soul finds the cure.

verse: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
hadith: None of you has faith until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
quote: Even a butterfly catcher walks softly; you, who seek hearts, do not offend anyone.

verse: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better.
hadith: The strong man is not the good wrestler, but the strong man is he who controls himself when he is angry.
quote: Tolerance is the most beautiful garment of love.

verse: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe?
hadith: There are two blessings which many people lose: health and free time.
quote: He who knows himself knows his Lord.

verse: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds.
hadith: Every religion has a distinct characteristic, and the distinct characteristic of Islam is modesty.
quote: Repentance is the most beautiful water that washes away the dirt of sin.

verse: But My mercy encompasses all things.
hadith: Those who are merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful.
quote: Love is a cure. Love is power. Love is the seal of change.

verse: And know that Allah intervenes between a man and his heart.
hadith: Supplication is the weapon of the believer.
quote: The heart is the house of Allah. Only His love suits there.

verse: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam.
hadith: I and the one who sponsors an orphan will be in Paradise like these two.
quote: The greatest wealth of a person is their honesty.

verse: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you.
hadith: Whoever relieves a Muslim of a burden from the burdens of the world, Allah will relieve him of a burden from the burdens on the Day of Judgement.
quote: To be with the Truth while among the people is the sign of a saint.

verse: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
hadith: No one has ever eaten better food than that which he earned with his own hands.
quote: Knowledge elevates the lowly, and ignorance degrades the noble.

verse: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives.
hadith: Wealth does not consist of having many possessions, but true wealth is the wealth of the soul.
quote: Generosity is the yeast of friendship.

verse: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you.
hadith: A talebearer will not enter Paradise.
quote: Gossip is the dirt of the soul.

verse: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
hadith: Make things easy and do not make them difficult.
quote: Destiny is the most beautiful poem written for a person, but one must read it to understand.

verse: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'
hadith: The rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim are five: returning the greeting, visiting the sick, following the funeral processions, accepting invitations, and replying to the sneezer.
quote: Despair is the strongest weapon of the devil.

verse: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision.
hadith: Charity does not decrease wealth.
quote: If we share, we are full; if we divide, we disappear.

verse: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers.
hadith: I guarantee a house on the outskirts of Paradise for one who leaves arguments even if he is right.
quote: Peace begins within one's own heart.

verse: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance.
hadith: There are two statements that are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful: 'Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi, Subhan-Allahil-Azim'.
quote: Keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah.

verse: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth.
hadith: Two eyes will not be touched by Hellfire: an eye that weeps from the fear of Allah, and an eye that spends the night guarding in the cause of Allah.
quote: If no tears flow from the eyes, it means the heart has dried up.

verse: Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.
hadith: Whoever among you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; if he cannot, then with his tongue; if he cannot, then with his heart.
quote: The best answer to evil is goodness.

verse: And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth.
hadith: Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his guest.
quote: The guest comes with his provision, and leaves having erased the sins (of the host).

verse: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them.
hadith: A man follows the religion of his friend; so each one should consider whom he makes his friend.
quote: The nightingale takes you to the rose, and the crow to the dump.

verse: And eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good.
hadith: There is a piece of flesh in the body if it becomes good the whole body becomes good but if it gets spoilt the whole body gets spoilt and that is the heart.
quote: He whose stomach is full of the unlawful, his heart cannot be filled with faith.

verse: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day.
hadith: The best of you are those who have the best manners and character.
quote: Just as the fragrance of a rose spreads, so does the fragrance of good character.
